story_type: crewed launch filmed from a helicopter offshore, rocket climbs through cloud
hook: Four people ride this rocket. A helicopter flew alongside.
narration: Four people are strapped in on top of this rocket.
A NASA helicopter hovered offshore to film the launch of Crew-11.
NASA astronauts Zena Cardman and Mike Fincke flew with JAXA astronaut Kimiya Yui and cosmonaut Oleg Platonov.
The camera follows them up through a layer of cloud, the Dragon capsule riding on top.
outcome: Endeavour carried all four toward a long stay on the space station.
title: Crew-11 launch seen from a helicopter
question_comment: Would you rather ride the rocket or film it from the helicopter?

facts.source_quote: NASA astronauts Zena Cardman and Mike Fincke, JAXA astronaut Kimiya Yui and Roscosmos cosmonaut Oleg Platonov launched in a SpaceX Dragon spacecraft named Endeavour atop a Falcon 9 rocket
to begin their long-duration stay aboard the orbiting laboratory.

description:
A NASA helicopter films the SpaceX Crew-11 launch from Kennedy Space Center on Aug. 1, 2025, as the Falcon 9 carries four astronauts in the Dragon Endeavour up through the clouds toward the International Space Station.
